method: Manual transcription of retained independent observations, with direct reinspection of the unchanged PNG. Fail means not established as well as contradicted. No inferred hidden anatomy, plant count, reviewer authentication, pixel classifier or new art acceptance.

scene.evidence: Three distinct animal bodies; the intended Platypus retains rounded external ears and upright mammalian proportions.

Left foreground instead of the required right anchor; approximately twice the requested complete-subject width.

identity.evidence: One separate dark furry body has a broad rubbery bill and a flat-looking tail tip. Visible rounded external ears, raised head/chest, high belly and long upright mammalian legs contradict the low monotreme body plan. Foot digits are visible but broad webbing is not clearly resolved. The tail narrows into a long stalk before the paddle-like tip. Round rodent-like ears are an explicit forbidden substitution. A bill and paddle tip do not establish a correct Platypus. Faces right although the recipe requests left; substantially wider than the requested 20 percent.
